key_risks.title: Power team, zero parametric
key_risks.body: Syndicate 5000's dedicated London power and utilities bench scores underwriting_expertise 4/4, but disclosed non-damage product count is zero (trigger_gap 4/4, product_fit 0/4). UK wind, solar and BESS cedants on the Energy line (6% of USD 560m gross premium) inherit indemnity BI only — unlike Munich Re's disclosed parametric structures. Absent trigger: indexed availability / parametric yield cover on standard renewals.

key_risks.title: Proxy UK boundary clustering
key_risks.body: Aggregation/correlation scores 3/4 from a register-derived portfolio proxy (HHI 0.93 over 46 mapped L3 assets) — no public covered-asset register on Syndicate 5000 itself. A single UK transmission-constraint event could hit multiple energy accounts Travelers writes in the same quarter; syndicate capital is not separately modelled for correlated curtailment.

key_risks.title: Engineering-led, no grid model
key_risks.body: Data_monitoring 2/4 and pricing_modelling 1/4 — engineering-led risk assessment on power accounts without published curtailment telemetry or constraint-pricing methodology. Deep physical-peril expertise on the power team does not extend to availability-index pricing for UK grid-firmness losses.

key_risks.title: Builders risk, not curtailment
key_risks.body: Zurich's Data Center Project Guard and 245+ data-centre projects in 2025 signal active UK/EU construction appetite (book_concentration 2/4), but disclosed non-damage product count is one construction-focused parametric (trigger_gap 3/4, product_fit 1/4). Operational grid curtailment and availability-index cover for energised DC and renewables clients remain absent — Descartes and Munich Re offer parametric structures Zurich does not match post-COD.

key_risks.title: Ten-year cover, three-year history
key_risks.body: Disclosed max cover tenor T=10y vs claims history H=3y yields tenor_mismatch 4/4 — the widest gap in batch7 L1 carriers. Long-dated DC and energy programmes underwritten today assume a curtailment-loss record that does not yet exist; pricing_modelling 2/4 covers construction-delay indices only, not NESO constraint dynamics.

key_risks.title: Culham–Latos register cluster
key_risks.body: Register-linked aggregation on two mapped assets (asset-latos-bridgend, asset-culham-aigz) yields HHI 0.5 across east England and southern boundaries — aggregation/correlation effective 3.7/4. Zurich's AI Growth Zone and Bridgend DC exposures concentrate on the same constrained export corridors without disclosed curtailment triggers.

key_risks.title: MOD SLA outside BI
key_risks.body: Ark operates security-critical, MOD-adjacent infrastructure at Spring Park (~55 MW, Corsham) where government tenants require near-100% availability. A grid or mechanical failure triggering an SLA breach could incur contractual penalties and tenant migration costs — excluded from standard PD/BI wordings that require proximate physical damage (LMA BI guidance).

key_risks.title: M4 corridor multi-site correlation
key_risks.body: Ark's distributed UK estate spans the M4/Wiltshire corridor on the south-west transmission boundary (aggregation/correlation effective 3.4/4, HHI 1.0 single-zone). A regional grid fault or extreme weather event could simultaneously impact multiple campuses — property cat and BI programmes are structured per-site without explicit multi-site correlation caps.

key_risks.title: Diesel backup ≠ insurance trigger
key_risks.body: Campus-wide N+1 diesel (~33 generators at Spring Park) scores product_fit 3/4 as engineering resilience, not insurance cover — trigger_gap 1/4 reflects on-site backup but no parametric or availability product. Pricing_modelling 1/4; operational redundancy outruns trigger design for grid-lawful curtailment without equipment failure.

key_risks.title: Grid lag vs build cycle
key_risks.body: AWS cites multi-year grid-connection lead times versus two-year build cycles across European campuses (GBP 8bn UK infrastructure horizon, tenor_mismatch 3/4). Non-firm or delayed firm access is a disclosed planning risk — lawful curtailment without proximate physical damage falls outside standard PD/BI (trigger_gap 3/4).

key_risks.title: Slough hub single boundary
key_risks.body: Capacity spread across London/Slough facilities (Equinix LD-series, Ridgeway) converges behind the grid-constrained Slough–West London data-centre hub — aggregation/correlation effective 3.6/4 (HHI 1.0). Correlated curtailment or outage hits the full insured value stack; property cat aggregates at site level without grid-system correlation pricing.

key_risks.title: Compute SLA, no grid cover
key_risks.body: Hyperscaler telemetry scores data_monitoring 3/4 but product_fit 1/4 — no disclosed availability or parametric curtailment cover. Lawful curtailment or demand-response limits defer batch/inference workload — SLA penalties and migration cost without physical damage to plant; cyber outage covers vendor stack, not NESO constraint orders.

key_risks.title: Docklands curtailment, no damage
key_risks.body: Fully operational DR facility running ~3.5 MVA load on ten-year lease through 2029 — Docklands grid demand growth could trigger lawful curtailment without damage to insured plant (trigger_gap 3/4). Standard PD/BI wordings do not respond; curtailment is not a proximate physical-damage event under LMA BI guidance.

key_risks.title: Isle of Dogs neighbour stack
key_risks.body: Single dedicated 34,875 sq ft facility on Greenwich View estate alongside multiple neighbouring data-centre buildings sharing local power infrastructure — aggregation/correlation effective 3.8/4 (HHI 1.0). Correlated outage or curtailment hits full DR value; book_concentration 3/4 on one operational node.

key_risks.title: 2029 lease reversion gap
key_risks.body: Savills auction listing documents Bloomberg occupation on lease through 2029 — insurance programme continuity, declared values and grid-connection assignment at reversion are undisclosed. Operational PD/BI may lapse or reprice at lease event; no curtailment product evidenced in either period (product_fit 1/4).

key_risks.title: Winter solar import exposure
key_risks.body: Brightwell 8 MW private-wire solar supplies ~50% of annual campus energy and up to 90% on peak summer days — winter and evening NOC load relies entirely on grid import (~11 MVA allocated). Lawful curtailment on telco operational DC load would not trigger standard BI (trigger_gap 3/4); no parametric cover bridges seasonal grid-import dependency.

key_risks.title: 11→40 MVA on one node
key_risks.body: Single 100-acre campus hosting BT's main R&D site, Network Operations Centre and operational DC load on one Martlesham Primary allocation — UKPN documents flag potential growth to 40 MVA (book_concentration 3/4, aggregation/correlation effective 3.6/4). Property cat aggregates at site; grid-system curtailment correlation rarely priced.

key_risks.title: NOC telemetry, no trigger
key_risks.body: Network Operations Centre and intelligent PDU monitoring score data_monitoring 3/4 — above generic telco benchmarks — but product_fit 2/4 reflects on-site solar mitigation only, not insurance availability cover. Pricing_modelling 1/4; strong operational monitoring outruns trigger design for grid-lawful curtailment.

key_risks.title: B5 de-dispatch without damage
key_risks.body: 500 MW/1 GWh BESS at Broken Cross sited on the B5 Scottish boundary to absorb curtailed wind — FID early 2026, COD targeted late 2027. B5 boundary constraints can force BESS de-dispatch without equipment damage; merchant and BM revenue loss sits outside damage-only property cover (trigger_gap 3/4, margin_of_safety −50.0).

key_risks.title: Coalburn 1+2 co-location
key_risks.body: Very large single site on one constrained Scottish B5 transmission boundary, co-located with Coalburn 1 (500 MW/1 GWh) — aggregation/correlation 4/4 (HHI 1.0), book_concentration 4/4. Single-boundary correlated curtailment hits both phases; CIP portfolio concentration not separately capital-modelled for constraint de-dispatch.

key_risks.title: Zero BESS availability product
key_risks.body: Product_fit 0/4 and pricing_modelling 0/4 — no availability or parametric curtailment product identified; revenue hedging through merchant, capacity market and SSE offtake does not transfer grid-firmness risk. Underwriting_expertise 0/4 at asset level; CIP and AIP are investors, not risk carriers.

key_risks.title: Pre-build connection slip
key_risks.body: DCO granted September 2024 with a National Grid 600 MW connection offer but no public Gate 1/2 firmness confirmation under NESO's reformed connections regime — construction versus energisation timing risk (tenor_mismatch 4/4). Pre-build greenfield with trigger_gap 4/4: no availability or parametric cover for connection delay or curtailment risk.

key_risks.title: Cottam corridor NSIP stack
key_risks.body: Up to 600 MW solar plus 600 MW BESS across four parcels converges on a single 400 kV point of connection at the former Cottam coal substation — aggregation/correlation 4/4, book_concentration 4/4. Shares the corridor with neighbouring Gate Burton and other NSIPs; correlated constraint risk across co-located projects rarely priced in property cat.

key_risks.title: 40-year asset, zero cover
key_risks.body: 40-year NSIP asset horizon (margin_of_safety −46.2, quadrant exposed) against product_fit 1/4 and data_monitoring 1/4 — no operational curtailment history and no evidence of availability or parametric protection in the document library. Infirm connection may cap export below 1,200 MW nameplate without equipment failure.

key_risks.title: 500 MW needs undelivered grid
key_risks.body: Culham selected for dual-resilient 132kV/400kV grid with ~100 MW confirmed spare capacity, but expansion toward 500 MW peak requires additional network reinforcement not yet delivered (book_concentration 4/4, tenor_mismatch 3/4). Scale-up tranches beyond ~200 MW enter infirm-connection territory — capacity derating without equipment failure (dominant channel: capacity derating).

key_risks.title: Operator TBD — cover unplaced
key_risks.body: UKAEA-led AI Growth Zone with expression-of-interest process underway to select a strategic investor/operator — insurance programme ownership, declared values and commercial PD/BI placement remain unallocated during procurement. Government entities may self-insure or use Crown Cover with different terms from commercial parametric or availability products.

key_risks.title: Firm tranche, latent trigger
key_risks.body: Initial 100 MW tranche has firm-connection backing (non_firm_compute_exposure 0/4 on TEC register) and dual-resilient feeds score product_fit 3/4 — but trigger_gap 2/4 reflects no availability or parametric cover for upper-tranche curtailment once reinforcement slips. Zurich maps this asset in its register-linked book (HHI 0.5 with Latos Bridgend).

key_risks.title: 1.2 GW on 1 GW export
key_risks.body: Each phase holds a secured 1 GW grid connection but may install up to 1.2 GW — operational curtailment whenever turbine output exceeds the export limit (trigger_gap 3/4). Forewind modelling optimises annual yield but guarantees routine curtailment at the onshore substation; lost MWh not recoverable under damage-only BI or CfD revenue stack.

key_risks.title: 3.6 GW phased aggregation
key_risks.body: World's largest offshore wind complex at 3.6 GW across three 1.2 GW phases — phases A and B share the Creyke Beck 400 kV export point while phase C uses Lackenby, creating correlated curtailment at two adjacent onshore nodes (aggregation/correlation effective 3.8/4, book_concentration 4/4).

key_risks.title: SCADA depth, zero parametric
key_risks.body: Utility-scale offshore SCADA with HVDC telemetry scores data_monitoring 3/4 and capital_reinsurance 4/4 (SSE, Equinor, Vårgrønn project finance) — but product_fit 0/4 with no curtailment or parametric insurance at asset level. Pricing_modelling 1/4; merchant upside eroded by overplanting curtailment without insurable trigger.

key_risks.title: EC5 export until reinforcement
key_risks.body: NESO East Anglia Network Study models EC5 as a thermal export limit — as TWO/THREE/ONE North connect, generators behind the boundary face increasing constraint payments rather than full merchant export (non_firm_intensity 3/4, 74% flexible TEC share). Constraint payments partially offset lost revenue but are not insurance; damage-only BI does not respond.

key_risks.title: 3.9 GW hub single zone
key_risks.body: East Anglia Hub clusters over 3.9 GW across four projects (ONE operational, TWO/THREE/ONE North building) in one southern North Sea zone converging on the EC5 export boundary — aggregation/correlation effective 3.8/4, book_concentration 4/4. Correlated constraint risk grows as later phases energise; margin_of_safety −41.5, quadrant exposed.

key_risks.title: GBP 10bn, zero parametric
key_risks.body: GBP 10 bn multi-phase hub financing with 30+ year asset life (tenor_mismatch 4/4) but product_fit 0/4 — no evidence of curtailment or parametric insurance at asset level. East Anglia ONE runs full offshore SCADA (data_monitoring 3/4) yet trigger_gap 3/4 leaves merchant revenue loss from lawful curtailment outside standard operational programmes.

key_risks.title: B4 curtailment zeros revenue
key_risks.body: Field's largest BESS (50 MW/100 MWh, operational September 2025) sits north of the heavily constrained B4 boundary — lawful curtailment can zero merchant revenue without equipment failure (trigger_gap 4/4, curtailment=high). Standard PD/BI wordings do not respond; margin_of_safety −37.5, quadrant exposed.

key_risks.title: 44% non-firm TEC register
key_risks.body: NESO TEC register shows 44% MW-weighted flexible/non-firm share on the B4 boundary cluster (non_firm_intensity 2/4) — aggregation/correlation 4/4 (HHI 1.0 single-zone). All capacity behind one severely constrained Northern Scotland boundary; correlated curtailment hits full insured value stack without separate capital modelling.

key_risks.title: Gaia telemetry, no trigger
key_risks.body: Field's in-house Gaia trading platform scores data_monitoring 3/4 with full BM participation — but product_fit 1/4 and pricing_modelling 1/4 with no public availability or parametric cover. GBP 42m project debt against very short revenue history (tenor_mismatch 4/4); merchant optimiser models constraint exposure, insurance does not.
